title: Unsettling Lamp
description: Each combat, the first time you play a card that [gold]Debuffs[/gold] an enemy, double its effect.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks the first card played in each combat that applies a debuff effect. Once identified, all debuff effects applied by that specific card during the same combat are doubled. Resets after combat ends or once the triggering card is played.
